body.value: Two German shops have stopped trading — a count of premises on Contoso's store register whose country is Germany and which carry a day they closed: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, closed 4 April 2015, and Brandenburg, closed 8 August 2019. They stood on two different places. NOT INCLUDED: the eight German shops still trading with no closing date; stores in the other seven countries; and the online store, which carries the '--' sentinel rather than a country and is German under no reading. No period is involved — this is the state the register records, not closures within a window — and nothing about sales, staff or floor area is counted. The one thing the figure hides: the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern closure was a rebuild, and a replacement shop opened on that same site in August 2015 and still trades, so if you meant places now dark, that is one rather than two.

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.country_code = 'DE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS premises_by_store_row,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.country_code = 'DE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS premises_by_site_country,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        s.country_code = 'DE'
      ) <> (
        l.country_code = 'DE'
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS rows_where_readings_disagree,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.country_code = 'DE' THEN s.location_code END) AS distinct_german_sites,
  LISTAGG(
    
      s.store_key || ' site' || s.location_code || ' ' || COALESCE(CAST(s.close_date AS TEXT), 'OPEN') || ' ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(s.status_annotation, ''), 'blank'),
      ' / '
    
    ORDER BY
      s.location_code,
      s.store_key
  ) AS roster
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
LEFT JOIN contoso_served.dim_location AS l
  ON s.location_code = l.location_code
WHERE
  s.country_code = 'DE' OR l.country_code = 'DE'
